title: Westland Boatyard & Marina
specs: Located on the Intracoastal Waterway in Titusville, Florida
Basin well-protected from waves with depth of 8 to 12 feet
Depth in Approach Channel is 7-9 feet
No discernable tide due to locks at Port Canaveral
includes: Boaters lounge indoor and pavilion outdoor
gap: Prices for wet slips and dry yard not stated
blurb: Westland Boatyard and Marina offers 55 wet slips and a 6+ acre do-it-yourself upland dry yard. The marina has a travel lift for boats up to 60' and 50 tons. Services include bottom painting, diesel/gas mechanic, outboard servicing and repairs, welding, rigging, fiberglass/gelcoat repair, and general refurbishing by outside contractors.
